description: rebaseWhen is 'auto', not the preset's 'behind-base-branch': this repo has a merge queue, so a PR need not be up to date to enqueue, and forced rebases would re-run the full matrix on every open PR each time main moves.

packageRules.description: React 19 is unreachable: @just-web/react@9 (latest) peers on react ^16 || ^17 || ^18, and react-codemirror2-react-17 is React-17-only. Drop this rule once @just-web/react declares a react ^19 peer.
Storybook 10.5 supports vitest ^3 || ^4 (@storybook/addon-vitest) and vite <=8; lift when Storybook supports vitest 5.
